OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector. This connector drives its own polling loop from 'DATADOG_IMPORT_INTERVAL', so this value is only used to satisfy the manager-supported contract.

DATADOG_TOKEN.description: The DataDog API key used to authenticate against the DataDog API.

DATADOG_APP_KEY.description: The DataDog Application key. Required by the Security Monitoring v2 API, which rejects calls missing it with a 403.

DATADOG_API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the DataDog API (site-dependent).

DATADOG_APP_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the DataDog web application, used to build the external references pointing back to each signal.

DATADOG_IMPORT_INTERVAL.description: The interval, in minutes, between two runs of the connector.

DATADOG_IMPORT_START_DATE.description: The ISO 8601 date to start importing signals from on the very first run (e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

DATADOG_MAX_TLP.description: The TLP marking applied to every emitted STIX object. Available values are: TLP:CLEAR, TLP:WHITE, TLP:GREEN, TLP:AMBER, TLP:AMBER+STRICT, TLP:RED.

DATADOG_BATCH_SIZE.description: The page size used when paginating the DataDog Security Monitoring API (DataDog caps this at 1000).

DATADOG_IMPORT_ALERTS.description: Whether to import DataDog security signals (alerts).

DATADOG_CREATE_INCIDENT_RESPONSE_CASES.description: Whether to create a Case-Incident response object for each imported security signal.

DATADOG_ALERT_PRIORITIES.description: Comma-separated list of signal priorities to import (e.g. 'P1,P2'). Defaults to every priority.

DATADOG_ALERT_TAGS_FILTER.description: Comma-separated list of DataDog tags used to filter the imported signals (e.g. 'env:prod,team:secops'). Empty means no filtering.

DATADOG_EXTRACT_OBSERVABLES_FROM_ALERTS.description: Whether to extract the observables (IP addresses, domains, URLs, user-agents, email addresses) embedded in the signal payload.

DATADOG_INCLUDE_ALERT_CONTEXT.description: Whether to emit an explanatory Note carrying the DataDog tags, monitor query and assignee context of each signal.
